description: Two-stage variant of Nebulento: intents are filed under a domain == skill_id, a top-level classifier picks the domain first, then only that domain's sub-container fuzzy-matches the intent. Same nebulento distribution and confidence gate as nebulento-medium, registered under a separate opm.pipeline entry point (HierarchicalNebulentoPipeline in nebulento/opm.py).
notes: Same medium-confidence gate and thresholds as nebulento-medium; 'domain_threshold': 0.0 keeps the top-level domain gate disabled (matches the shipped default) so the comparison isolates the two-stage routing shape. Hypothesis: domain-first routing should help precision on large multi-domain intent sets by rejecting cross-domain fuzzy near-misses before they compete, and be roughly neutral-to-worse on small single-domain sets where there is no domain structure to exploit.
